en.headline: Yuen Long large-dog owner charged over fatal attacks appears in court, granted bail
en.dek: A 52-year-old man faces two counts of allowing a large dog to enter a public place without a secure leash; the case was adjourned to 29 October and he was released on HK$3,000 cash bail.
body: The 52-year-old owner of the large mixed-breed dog that killed two small pets near YOHO Mall in Yuen Long on 17 August appeared at Tuen Mun Magistrates’ Courts on Thursday.

Ng Sui-ting faces two charges under the Dangerous Dogs Regulation of allowing a large dog to enter or remain in a public place without being securely held on a leash not exceeding two metres. The alleged incidents occurred on 10 July and 17 August outside YOHO Mall and at Yoho Mix outdoor plaza.

Acting Principal Magistrate Tang Siu-hung adjourned the case to 29 October at the prosecution’s request. The defendant was granted HK$3,000 cash bail on condition that he remain in Hong Kong, live at his reported address and not contact prosecution witnesses. The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department is still considering further charges under the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Ordinance.

zh.headline: 元朗大狗咬斃兩犬案 狗主提堂准3千元保釋
zh.dek: 52歲男狗主被控兩項容受大型狗隻在公眾地方未穩妥牽引罪，屯門裁判法院押後至10月29日再訊，被告准以3,000元現金保釋。
body: 元朗形點附近8月17日發生大型混種犬咬死兩隻小狗事件，涉事52歲男狗主今日在屯門裁判法院提堂。
被告伍瑞庭被控兩項《危險狗隻規例》下的「容受大型狗隻進入或留在公眾地方」罪，指他於7月10日及8月17日容許一隻雄性黃色混種狗，在沒有以長度不超逾兩米的狗帶穩妥牽引下，進入YOHO Mall及形點戶外廣場的公眾地方。
署理主任裁判官鄧少雄應控方申請，將案件押後至10月29日再訊。被告准以3,000元現金保釋，期間不得離港、須居於報稱住址及不得接觸控方證人。漁護署仍考慮根據《防止殘酷對待動物條例》加控其他罪名。
